plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the brewlog-mobile system, validating all tab views, the brew logging flow, data visualization states, and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: The exploration will proceed by first validating the primary Today screen and its interactions. It will then move to the Add screen to test the form inputs and logging flow. Next, it will assess the Stats and Beans screens for data visualization and management. Finally, it will repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to evaluate responsive behavior and layout warnings.
assumptions: The application is a single-page app (index.html) where navigation occurs via the bottom tab bar and content is toggled dynamically.
The 29 inputs detected belong primarily to the Add (Log a brew) screen and may include various input types like text, number, and select.
The small tap target warning for the '+ Log' button may indicate broader mobile UX issues on the Today screen.
risk_hotspots: Small tap target on '+ Log' button (64x32px) on the Today screen
Form validation and error recovery on the Add brew screen (29 inputs)
Data visualization rendering and readability on the Stats screen
Layout shifting and edge-to-edge behavior when switching to mobile viewport (≤460px)

phases.title: Explore Today Screen
phases.objective: Validate the default Today screen layout, brew list interactions, and the '+ Log' button.
key_checks: Verify brew entries are displayed correctly under TODAY and YESTERDAY
Click the '+ Log' button and verify it navigates to or opens the Add brew screen
Check for layout issues and the small tap target warning on the '+ Log' button

phases.title: Test Add Brew Flow
phases.objective: Exercise the brew logging form, validate inputs, and test submission/cancellation.
key_checks: Navigate to Add screen via tab bar
Interact with various form inputs (text, numbers, selectors)
Attempt to submit an empty form to check validation
Fill out and submit a valid brew log
Cancel or close the form and verify state preservation/reset
exit_criteria: All input types on the Add screen interacted with

phases.title: Validate Stats & Beans Screens
phases.objective: Assess the data visualization on the Stats screen and bean management on the Beans screen.
key_checks: Navigate to Stats screen and verify 'Score over time', 'Method mix', and 'Top tasting notes' sections render
Navigate to Beans screen and verify 'Most-used beans' and bean list display
Check for any interactive elements or drill-downs in the visualizations
exit_criteria: All bottom tab navigation states exercised

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Checks
phases.objective: Repeat critical flows on a mobile viewport to validate responsive design and touch targets.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify edge-to-edge layout and notch/home indicator handling
Re-verify the '+ Log' button tap target size and bottom tab bar usability
Check Stats screen chart readability on a smaller screen
Validate Add brew form usability and input scrolling on mobile
exit_criteria: Mobile layout renders correctly without overflow
Touch targets meet 44px guidance or issues are documented
Critical user flow (view today, add brew, check stats) completed on mobile

coverage_targets.pages: Deeply explore the single-page application across all 4 tab views
coverage_targets.features: Interact with all bottom tabs, the + Log button, and a representative sample of the 29 form inputs
coverage_targets.mobile: Validate all 4 tab views and the primary add brew flow on mobile viewport

notes: Since this is a single HTML file, focus is on state transitions rather than page loads.
Pay special attention to the transition between desktop phone-frame view and actual mobile edge-to-edge view.
